minutes.headline: Water district board will seek more attorney and engineer proposals; only minutes were voted on
minutes.summary: The board approved prior minutes and reviewed two proposals for a new municipal attorney, deciding to look for more candidates before interviewing anyone. It discussed Stantec's slow response on the Mass Ave water main and GIS mapping, and leaned toward seeking proposals from other engineering firms. A sign question, and a silting and culvert concern near a resident's property, were also discussed.

budget_items.what_was_said: Members compared Unitil and National Grid electric costs and noted a Unitil bill near eight thousand and a Lancaster one near seven thousand.
A member said the commissioners' usual payment is made in June.
Money was appropriated at the annual meeting and the project is to go out to bid so it is ready when funds are available July 1.

budget_items.what_was_said: Members noted that paid police details would be required either way, whether in the engineering plan or if the district does the work itself.

Ask other water districts which attorneys they use, and call around to towns the next day.
Consider asking other engineering firms for proposals, after first calling Stantec to press for the Mass Ave bid plan.
Superintendent to follow up with the attorney about the sign and confirm with all parties before putting it up.

what_happened.line: The board took no votes on policy; the only item put to a vote was approval of the April 28 minutes.
The board reviewed two proposals for a municipal attorney and decided to seek more before interviewing anyone, asking other water districts which attorneys they use.
Members discussed Stantec's slow response on the Mass Ave water main and leaned toward asking other engineering firms for proposals, after first calling Stantec about the bid plan.
The superintendent is to follow up with the attorney about a district sign and confirm with all parties before it goes up.
A silting and culvert concern across the street from a resident's property was raised, with follow-up with the resident.

why_it_matters: Who advises the district on legal questions and who engineers the Mass Ave water main are both open, and the main's bid plan is the step that readies the project for when appropriated funds become available July 1.
Water district money is raised from the district's own users, so a change of engineering firm or attorney bears on project timing and on the cost of the work the annual meeting funded.
